execution_authorization: NOT GRANTED. No candidate frame may be rendered, displayed, or transmitted to any auditor, agent or panel until the user authorizes stage 1 in writing. Building and testing extraction tooling on synthetic inputs is permitted.

A3.definition: A window is A3-positive iff both blinded auditors return NOT VISIBLE for every audited frame in every one of the 3 audit cameras. An UNSURE verdict anywhere prevents A3.
A3.interpretation: 3-view unobservability. An UPPER BOUND on physical absence and NEVER a certification of it: invisibility in 3 of the applicable cameras is implied by absence but does not imply it.

A_S.definition: An A3-positive window is A_S-positive iff every camera in the sequence's applicable set S_seq returns NOT VISIBLE from both auditors at at least 3 audited frames including the window midpoint and the last v==0 frame.
A_S.interpretation: full-applicable-camera unobservability. This is NOT literal physical absence and may not be described as such anywhere. Human confirmation validates the OPERATIONAL VISUAL LABEL only; it does not observe physical ground truth.
A_S.grade: claim-grade ONLY with per-positive human confirmation

R_S.definition: An A_S-positive window is R_S-positive iff, in the post-window frames, the same identity reappears within r_site_census of its disappearance position under the sealed census return rule.
R_S.grade: claim-grade ONLY with per-positive human confirmation

population.frame: the 597 corrected screened-half true-absence candidate windows of tranche 1
population.all_conclusions_are_relative_to: the frozen candidate generator; a scarcity finding is about THIS candidate set, never about the scene or the dataset
population.N_s_source: the 20 sealed screening censuses runs/elgs/m1c2_screen_<seq>_r0/census.json, with the corrected conversions substituted for writing_2 and xylophone

sequence_sets.E_eligible: sequences classed eligible by A1, restricted to those with N_s > 0
sequence_sets.indeterminate_rule: E_indeterminate sequences MAY be audited descriptively and their per-sequence numbers reported, but they CANNOT enter a winning 3-subset unless a deterministic, statistically justified coverage-adjudication rule is separately frozen, signed, and passed BEFORE any event frame of theirs is inspected.
sequence_sets.E_select_change_requires: a new signed revision of this file; E_select may never be widened after any audit outcome is seen

applicable_camera_set.status: BLOCKING FINDING -- UNRESOLVED. Stage 1 may not execute until a reviewer or the user selects a definition in a signed revision.
applicable_camera_set.requirement_as_stated: frozen before any candidate outcome is viewed; derived from sealed calibration and camera validity only; never from auditor verdicts, candidate-specific track visibility, or candidate mask occupancy
applicable_camera_set.finding: On the DiVa-360 rig, with this candidate set, a FULLY candidate-independent applicable-camera set that is also geometrically usable does not exist. Measured, not argued -- see the evidence block below.

D2_predeclared_volume.definition: cameras whose frustum contains a ball centred at the tracking-camera centroid of radius k * rig_radius, tested on a 26-point lattice
D2_predeclared_volume.measurement: |S_seq| is 13 at k=0.10, 7 at k=0.15, 6 at k=0.20, 2 at k=0.25 and 0 at k=0.30, identically for all 12 sequences (one shared rig, rig_radius 5.028). The frozen anchors sit at 0.26 to 0.69 * rig_radius from the centroid (soda's single anchor at 1.955). So containing the anchors needs k >= 0.69 while retaining 3 cameras needs k <= 0.20.
D2_predeclared_volume.verdict: REFUTED. The feasible set of radii is empty.

D1_all_cameras_fixed_triple.definition: S_seq = all 26 tracking cameras; the 3 audit cameras are the triple maximising minimum pairwise optical-axis separation, which is (7, 37, 46) at 116.2 degrees for every sequence
D1_all_cameras_fixed_triple.measurement: the fixed triple's frusta contain all three of a candidate's anchor in only 14 of E_select's 49 frozen windows (28.6%), and 32 of 73 (43.8%) across all 12 sequences
D1_all_cameras_fixed_triple.verdict: AVAILABLE BUT DESTRUCTIVE. Applying the geometric-admissibility exclusion would cut the stage-1 sample from 49 to 14 windows in E_select, which by the power analysis collapses the kill rule's decidability.

D3_census_per_candidate_frustum.definition: the census generator's own rule: cameras whose frustum contains the candidate's FROZEN anchor (prereg_m1_census_v1 frustum_containment)
D3_census_per_candidate_frustum.candidate_independence_qualified: candidate-SPECIFIC but strictly OUTCOME-INDEPENDENT: purely geometric, frozen in a signed prereg, computed from the sealed candidate record, and incapable of responding to an auditor verdict
D3_census_per_candidate_frustum.measurement: |S| per window is 3 to 26 with pooled median 23, and 100% of the 73 windows have at least 3 applicable cameras. The best-separated triple within each candidate's own set has minimum axis separation 104-116 degrees for every sequence except soda (28.7 degrees, whose single window has |S| = 3 exactly).
D3_census_per_candidate_frustum.external_corroboration: recomputing this rule from sealed calibration reproduces the sealed audit_sample_B8 containing_cameras on 73 of 73 windows
D3_census_per_candidate_frustum.verdict: USABLE. Recommended, with the candidate-dependence disclosed as a limitation on what A_S may be said to mean.

applicable_camera_set.recommendation_requiring_SIGN_OFF: adopt D3, and state in every A_S claim that the applicable set was determined by the frozen candidate's own triangulated anchor, so A_S is unobservability across the cameras the CANDIDATE GENERATOR considered applicable -- not across an independently defined camera set
prohibited_regardless_of_choice: selecting cameras using per-report visibility flags
selecting cameras using candidate mask occupancy
changing the definition after any A3 verdict is seen
applicable_camera_set.data_quality_flag: soda_screen_w0_171's single frozen window has its anchor at 1.955 * rig_radius from the centroid, i.e. outside the camera sphere, with |S| = 3 and a best triple separation of 28.7 degrees. Under any definition this window is near-degenerate and must be reported separately rather than pooled silently.
applicable_camera_set.BLOCKING_IF: if the adopted definition leaves fewer than 3 applicable cameras for a window, that window is excluded from both the A3 numerator and its denominator, and the exclusion count is reported per sequence; a sequence left with no admissible window is removed from E_select and the removal is reported.

stage_1.purpose: a cheap validity screen plus a possible kill; never an admission

instrument.candidates: the frozen 73-window M1-A0b stratified sample from audit_sample_B8 of runs/elgs/m1absdiag_primary_fix4acb0fc_r0/diagnostic.json, UNCHANGED (seed 20260814, 3 rounds, per-stratum fresh RNG)
instrument.presence_decoys: at least 20 windows ASSOCIATED at v == 1 in at least 3 cameras with consensus reprojection RMS at most 2 px, drawn from the same sequences and the same frame ranges
instrument.presentation: all candidates, decoys and recall probes shuffled into one indistinguishable stream; no auditor may be told which class a window belongs to, and no per-class counts may be disclosed before all verdicts are returned
instrument.views: the 3 audit cameras of S_seq x 5 uniformly strided frames of the window, endpoints included
instrument.context_given_to_the_auditor: the identity's pre-window reference crop only
instrument.auditors: two blinded auditors drawn from DIFFERENT model families

validity_gates.inter_auditor_agreement_scope: candidate and recall-probe windows only; decoys HELD OUT of this statistic
validity_gates.on_failure: VOID. No route inference of any kind is permitted from a void stage 1, in either direction.

estimator.per_sequence_bound: one-sided Clopper-Pearson UPPER bound UB_s on the A3 proportion among the sequence's audited windows
estimator.simultaneity: Bonferroni: each per-sequence bound is computed at confidence 1 - alpha/m with m = |E_select|, giving at least 90% simultaneous coverage
estimator.simultaneity_alternatives: a different simultaneous method is permitted only if mathematically specified, power-checked, and accepted by the fresh-context reviewer in a signed revision
estimator.direction_note: raising per-sequence confidence RAISES UB_s and therefore makes the kill HARDER; Bonferroni is conservative with respect to killing
estimator.also_reported_descriptively: the stratified Horvitz-Thompson estimate of the A3 count, which carries no decision weight

kill_rule.fires_iff: there exists NO three-sequence subset T of E_select with U_s >= 12 for every s in T AND sum of U_s over T >= 72
kill_rule.on_fire: record 'physical-absence-bearing candidates are scarce ON THE FROZEN CANDIDATE SET' and route the DiVa tranche-1 claim family to R3, stated relative to the candidate generator and carrying the recall caveat. The words 'route dead' are prohibited.
kill_rule.floors_provenance: 12 and 72 are the frozen cycle-2 selection-inequality floors and are NOT re-derived here

power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.method: enumerate every attainable outcome vector over the sequences that can reach the per-sequence floor and ask whether the kill can both fire and not fire
power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.E_select_of_10_result: DECIDABLE. Only 4 of the 10 have N_s >= 12 and can ever reach U_s >= 12 (pour_tea 73, tambourine 18, put_candy 18, tea 13). Over the 7,000 attainable outcome vectors the kill fires in 2,580 and does not in 4,420. The minimal surviving outcome is pour_tea >= 2, tambourine >= 1, put_candy >= 3 A3-positives.
power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.DEGENERACY_TRIPWIRE: if a future adjudication rule admits scissor, poker AND pour_tea to E_select simultaneously, the kill CANNOT FIRE under any outcome: at zero observed A3-positives those three alone give U = 93.7 + 45.0 + 30.1 = 168.8 >= 72 with each >= 12. Bonferroni is not the cause; the same holds at an uncorrected 90%.
power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.why: U_s = N_s * UB_s scales with the candidate count while UB_s is floored by the sample size, so a LARGER candidate population makes the kill harder, not easier
power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.consequence: admitting scissor turns stage 1 from a cheap screen into a near-census of that sequence. Any revision that admits scissor or poker MUST re-specify stage 1 before execution.

stage_2.population: ALL candidate windows of every sequence in E_select
pipeline_order: A_S pass on A3-positives: every camera in S_seq at >= 3 frames including the window midpoint and the last v == 0 frame
return pass on A_S-positives: post-window frames, same identity reappearing within r_site_census
human confirmation of EVERY A_S-positive and EVERY R_S-positive
stage_2.counts: exact per-sequence R_s from human-confirmed R_S-positives
stage_2.decision: the frozen cycle-2 selection inequality: there exists a 3-subset T of E_select with R_s >= 12 for every s in T and sum of R_s over T >= 72
stage_2.no_partial_credit: a model-auditor A_S or R_S positive that a human does not confirm is not counted, in either direction

recall_probe.reporting: reported as a standalone diagnostic with its own denominator, never combined with A3, A_S or R_S

evidence_grading.claim_grade_requires: preregistered human confirmation of EVERY counted A_S or R_S positive
evidence_grading.decoys_do_NOT_validate: sensitivity to difficult absence-like events, enclosure, reveal, or identity-ambiguous cases. Presence decoys bound the FALSE-POSITIVE side of the instrument only, and no sensitivity claim may rest on them.
evidence_grading.unmeasured: the instrument's miss rate on genuine full-view absence, which this design does not estimate because no window is known to be genuinely absent

anchor_association.rule: the sealed M-2 anchor definition and artifact, unchanged: the frozen candidate's ltp and ltp_frame from audit_sample_B8
anchor_association.prohibition: no new association rule may be introduced by this audit
anchor_association.independent_recomputation: must use this same frozen rule, or a hashed byte-equivalent implementation of it

tooling_boundary.permitted_now: build and test the frame-extraction and panel-assembly tooling on SYNTHETIC or DECOY-FREE inputs
tooling_boundary.prohibited_now: rendering, displaying, transmitting or storing any candidate window's imagery for auditor consumption
